summary: Crypto interest account product operated by BlockFi that became a landmark U.S. securities settlement in 2022 and later entered Chapter 11 bankruptcy after FTX contagion and withdrawal suspension.
what_happened: BlockFi offered interest-bearing crypto accounts beginning around 2019. In February 2022, the SEC announced a major settlement over the BlockFi Interest Account. In November 2022, after the FTX collapse and related exposure, BlockFi paused withdrawals and filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection. This record tracks the BlockFi Interest Account and related lending-platform collapse path.
uncertainty_notes: This record combines product-specific BIA regulatory history with the broader BlockFi platform bankruptcy. Customer recovery differs by account type, wallet/account status, and bankruptcy distribution mechanics.
notes: Added as a core CeFi interest-account failure and regulatory-history case.
